comment: 14 rows cover local-operation summary rules and review guards, one row for each rule.
The body-summary module is outside the compiler binary. The build compiles the focused test.
Run this table in the Linux VM after you build the debug preset.
Read the stage of each caught row: the second stage at -j 6 can time out on a 4-vCPU guest.
